definitions.explanation: The customs, arts, beliefs, and lifestyle practices associated with Japan. Used in both casual references and academic discussion.

examples.japanese: {日本文化|にほんぶんか}が{好|す}きだ。
{祭|まつ}りは{日本文化|にほんぶんか}の{大切|たいせつ}な{一部|いちぶ}だ。
examples.english: Festivals are an important part of Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {留学生|りゅうがくせい}に{日本文化|にほんぶんか}を{紹介|しょうかい}する{授業|じゅぎょう}を{担当|たんとう}している。
examples.english: I'm in charge of a class that introduces Japanese culture to international students.

notes:
Compound of {日本|にほん} (Japan) + {文化|ぶんか} (culture).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本文化|にほんぶんか}を{学|まな}ぶ: study Japanese culture
- {日本文化|にほんぶんか}に{触|ふ}れる: come into contact with Japanese culture
- {日本文化|にほんぶんか}を{紹介|しょうかい}する: introduce Japanese culture
- {伝統的|でんとうてき}な{日本文化|にほんぶんか}: traditional Japanese culture
- {日本文化|にほんぶんか}の{影響|えいきょう}: influence of Japanese culture
